title: imap e2e test config uses plaintext password, not bcrypt hash
description: test_config() in crates/imap/tests/e2e_smoke.rs sets UserCredential.password to plaintext "testpass" instead of a bcrypt hash. This makes the test config invalid — CredentialStore.check() calls bcrypt::verify which requires a bcrypt hash; passing plaintext always returns false. Current smoke tests pass only because they exercise plain-connection paths (LOGINDISABLED) where auth is never attempted, so the bad config is masked. A future test that exercises auth on TLS would silently get wrong results from this bad test fixture.
